rewrites.//: Single-page app: every path has to reach index.html so React Router can handle it, or a refresh on /learning/materials/phone-etiquette returns 404. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so real files (assets, emoji, sw.js, the manifest) are still served directly and do not need excluding here.

headers.//: Hashed build output and the vendored Lottie emoji never change under a given name, so they can be cached indefinitely.
This is an internal tool holding staff training records. Denying framing and sniffing costs nothing and removes two whole classes of attack.
